title: The lower envelope of ultraspherical polynomials
summary: Let $R_n^{(a,b)}=P_n^{(a,b)}/P_n^{(a,b)}(1)$ be the normalised Jacobi polynomials. For $α\ge0$, put $ξ_0=-1$ and let $ξ_n$ be the largest zero of $R_n^{(α+1,α)}$ for $n\ge1$. We prove that $$ R_k^{(α,α)}(x) =\min_{n\ge0}R_n^{(α,α)}(x), \quad ξ_{k-1}\le x\leξ_k, $$ for every $k\ge1$. This determines the pointwise lower envelope of the normalised ultraspherical polynomials and answers Question 2 posed by F. M. de Oliveira Filho in his 2009 thesis.
